description: Configuration for hybrid quadtree layout generation - 235×363 array with 36nt barcodes

library_configuration.comment: 12nt random tail appended after the 24nt quadtree portion

rll_configuration.comment: max_run=3 allows up to 3 consecutive bases (e.g., AAA ok, AAAA forbidden)

notes: Hybrid approach: 24nt quadtree + 12nt random tail = 36nt total
Quadtree portion provides spatial similarity for synthesis error tolerance
Random tail portion provides high Hamming distance for sequencing quality
RLL prevents homopolymers in quadtree portion only
